variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config
ssh_pwauth: __SSH_PASSWORD_AUTHENTICATION__
package_update: true
package_upgrade: false

packages:
  - ca-certificates
  - apt-transport-https
  - gnupg
  - lsb-release
  - git
  - curl
  - jq
  - unzip

write_files:
  - path: /etc/toolbox-admin-user
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0644'
    encoding: b64
    content: __ADMIN_USER_BASE64__
  - path: /usr/local/bin/verify-tools.sh
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0755'
    encoding: b64
    content: __VERIFY_TOOLS_BASE64__
  - path: /usr/local/sbin/install-toolbox.sh
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0755'
    content: |
      #!/usr/bin/env bash
      set -euo pipefail

      LOG_FILE=/var/log/toolbox-install.log
      exec > >(tee -a "${LOG_FILE}") 2>&1
      trap 'status=$?; printf "ERROR: toolbox installation failed at line %s (exit %s).\n" "$LINENO" "$status" >&2; exit "$status"' ERR
      export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
      export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

      if [[ "${EUID}" -ne 0 ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: run the installer as root." >&2
        exit 1
      fi

      rm -f /var/lib/toolbox-install-complete /var/log/toolbox-versions.log
      ADMIN_USER="$(cat /etc/toolbox-admin-user)"
      ADMIN_ENTRY="$(getent passwd "${ADMIN_USER}")"
      ADMIN_HOME="$(cut -d: -f6 <<< "${ADMIN_ENTRY}")"
      if [[ -z "${ADMIN_USER}" || "${ADMIN_USER}" == root || ! -d "${ADMIN_HOME}" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: toolbox admin user must exist and have a non-root home directory." >&2
        exit 1
      fi

      as_admin() {
        runuser -u "${ADMIN_USER}" -- env \
          HOME="${ADMIN_HOME}" USER="${ADMIN_USER}" LOGNAME="${ADMIN_USER}" \
          PATH="${PATH}" "$@"
      }

      echo "=== Installing base packages ==="
      apt-get update
      apt-get install -y ca-certificates apt-transport-https gnupg lsb-release git curl jq unzip

      INSTALLER_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
      trap 'rm -f -- "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azure-cli.sh" "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azd.sh"; rmdir -- "${INSTALLER_DIR}"' EXIT

      echo "=== Installing latest stable Azure CLI from Microsoft's APT repository ==="
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 5 \
          https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb -o "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azure-cli.sh"
      bash "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azure-cli.sh"
      AZ_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE="$(LC_ALL=C apt-cache policy azure-cli | awk '$1 == "Candidate:" { print $2 }')"
      if [[ -z "${AZ_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE}" || "${AZ_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE}" == '(none)' ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: no Azure CLI package candidate is available from the configured APT repositories." >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      AZ_PACKAGE_INSTALLED="$(dpkg-query --show --showformat='${Version}' azure-cli)"
      if ! dpkg --compare-versions "${AZ_PACKAGE_INSTALLED}" eq "${AZ_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE}"; then
        echo "ERROR: installed Azure CLI package ${AZ_PACKAGE_INSTALLED} does not match the latest APT candidate ${AZ_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE}." >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      printf 'Azure CLI package matches the latest APT candidate: %s\n' "${AZ_PACKAGE_INSTALLED}"
      AZ_VERSION="$(az version --output json | jq -er '."azure-cli"')"
      if ! dpkg --compare-versions "${AZ_VERSION}" ge 2.80.0; then
        echo "ERROR: Azure CLI ${AZ_VERSION} is older than required version 2.80.0." >&2
        exit 1
      fi

      echo "=== Installing current stable Azure Developer CLI ==="
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 5 \
          https://aka.ms/install-azd.sh -o "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azd.sh"
      bash "${INSTALLER_DIR}/azd.sh"

      echo "=== Installing Microsoft Foundry extension for ${ADMIN_USER} ==="
      FOUNDRY_EXTENSIONS="$(as_admin azd ext list --installed --no-prompt)"
      if awk '$1 == "microsoft.foundry" { found=1 } END { exit !found }' <<< "${FOUNDRY_EXTENSIONS}"; then
        as_admin azd ext update microsoft.foundry --no-prompt
      else
        as_admin azd ext install microsoft.foundry --no-prompt
      fi

      echo "=== Installing kubectl system-wide ==="
      az aks install-cli \
          --install-location /usr/local/bin/kubectl \
          --kubelogin-install-location /usr/local/bin/kubelogin

      echo "=== Installing Container Apps extension with preview support for ${ADMIN_USER} ==="
      as_admin az extension add --name containerapp --upgrade --allow-preview true --yes

      echo "=== Validating required tools as ${ADMIN_USER} ==="
      as_admin /usr/local/bin/verify-tools.sh | tee /var/log/toolbox-versions.log
      touch /var/lib/toolbox-install-complete
      echo "Toolbox installation completed successfully at $(date --utc --iso-8601=seconds)."

runcmd:
  - [bash, /usr/local/sbin/install-toolbox.sh]
variables.$fxv#1:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

trap 'status=$?; printf "ERROR: toolbox verification failed at line %s (exit %s).\n" "$LINENO" "$status" >&2; exit "$status"' ERR

for tool in az git curl jq azd kubectl dpkg awk; do
  if ! command -v "${tool}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: required command '${tool}' is not in PATH." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

echo "=== Azure CLI ==="
AZ_VERSION_JSON="$(az version --output json)"
printf '%s\n' "${AZ_VERSION_JSON}"
AZ_VERSION="$(jq -er '."azure-cli"' <<< "${AZ_VERSION_JSON}")"
if ! dpkg --compare-versions "${AZ_VERSION}" ge 2.80.0; then
  echo "ERROR: Azure CLI ${AZ_VERSION} is older than required version 2.80.0." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== Git ==="
git --version

echo "=== curl ==="
curl --version

echo "=== jq ==="
jq --version

echo "=== Azure Developer CLI ==="
azd version

echo "=== Foundry azd Extensions ==="
FOUNDRY_EXTENSIONS="$(azd ext list --installed --no-prompt)"
printf '%s\n' "${FOUNDRY_EXTENSIONS}"
if ! awk '$1 == "microsoft.foundry" { found=1 } END { exit !found }' <<< "${FOUNDRY_EXTENSIONS}"; then
  echo "ERROR: microsoft.foundry is not installed for the current user." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== kubectl ==="
kubectl version --client

echo "=== AKS Pod Sandboxing CLI capability ==="
AKS_HELP="$(az aks create --help)"
if [[ "${AKS_HELP}" != *--workload-runtime* ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Azure CLI does not expose the AKS --workload-runtime option." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "az aks create supports --workload-runtime; no aks-preview extension is required."

echo "=== Azure CLI Extensions ==="
az extension list --output table
CONTAINERAPP_VERSION="$(az extension show --name containerapp --query version --output tsv)"
if [[ -z "${CONTAINERAPP_VERSION}" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: the Container Apps extension has no installed version." >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf 'containerapp version: %s (installed with preview releases allowed)\n' "${CONTAINERAPP_VERSION}"

echo "All required toolbox checks passed."

linuxConfiguration.ssh: [if(equals(parameters('authenticationType'), 'sshPublicKey'), createObject('publicKeys', createArray(createObject('path', format('/home/{0}/.ssh/authorized_keys', parameters('adminUsername')), 'keyData', parameters('sshPublicKey')))), null())]
